scale.name: CPCB National Air Quality Index (India, launched 17 October 2014)
scale.method: Piecewise-linear sub-index per pollutant; overall AQI = worst (max) sub-index, per CPCB.

above_top_breakpoint: Concentrations above the top breakpoint get sub-index 500 (band Severe). CPCB publishes no extrapolation formula above the top breakpoint; the bulletin caps the index at 500.

grap.applies_to: National Capital Region (NCR) only; shown for no other city.
grap.source_name: CAQM, Revised GRAP Schedule for NCR and adjoining areas (revision 29.09.2026)
